title: beauty in simplicity
body:
i was looking for something not overwhelming, just pure habit tracking app. and it’s hit the nail on the head.

i’m neurodivergent and this app is an absolute blast. simple but very attractive design, which is also a very needed condition for me. also THE WIDGET that is clickable?? the best ever. thanks for the great app, wishing you luck with all future projects 🤙🏻
author: lizarddoro
